name: Southchip Semiconductor Technology
summary: Southchip Semiconductor Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a semiconductor design firm based in Shanghai, China, specializing in the creation of power and battery management solutions. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of products, including various types of charging integrated circuits like buck-boost, charge pump, linear, wireless, and system-on-chip (SoC) chargers. Additionally, its offerings encompass battery protection components, general-purpose and charge pump DC-DC converters, and display power supply units. Southchip also provides standard load switches, along with versions integrated with USB controllers, as well as controllers for flyback and synchronous rectification circuits. Furthermore, the company develops USB Power Delivery (PD)/DPDM controllers and PD PHY chips. These advanced semiconductor products are vital for applications across consumer electronics, automotive systems, and industrial equipment. Established in 2015, Southchip Semiconductor Technology operates from its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
